question: Can a one-character lexical sigil separate open semantic relation names from identifiers/operators while preserving current G9 relation names and avoiding the observed lexer ambiguity?

source_basis.prior_counterevidence: E2B replication exposed relation-word lexical ambiguity under the first compatibility patch

candidate.resolver_rule: parsed relation must resolve against a declared typed relation symbol; parser acceptance alone is not semantic acceptance
candidate.authority_rule: relation resolution never grants execution authority

interpretation.supports: A sigil-prefixed open-relation surface can remove identifier-vs-relation lexical ambiguity for the tested subset without renaming even digit-leading relation labels such as 4B_emits.
interpretation.next_falsifier: Generate/execute a real parser over the complete admitted G9+dialect corpus and compare @relation normalization against a declared-infix alternative for parse stability, diagnostics, roundtrip semantic_hash, mutation survival and reader/token cost.
